selection_contract: Strict zero-tolerance weak CSI admission against ORIGINAL in all 18 lead-by-threshold cells (leads 1-6; thresholds 0.1, 0.5, 1), then lead-1 CSI@10 must be strictly greater. Qualified candidates are ranked by lead-1 CSI@10, CSI@5, FAR@10, RMSE, then case ID; no averages.
scientific_scope: Gate is preferential QSNOW enhancement in columns selected from positive initial precipitating-water proxy X; alpha is 1 at/below the low quantile and increases smoothly to 3 at/above the high quantile. Equal-mass controls match diagnostic initial dry-mass-weighted QSNOW only. The intervention is nonconservative relative to ORIGINAL and makes no water, energy, or balance conservation claim.
remaining_limits: Forecast skill and the selection outcome are unknown until all eight pinned runs and scoring/recount complete.

This experiment isolates spatial placement against equal diagnostic initial QSNOW addition for each gate and crosses the B1 input/executable effects; it does not establish universal weak-versus-strong precipitation behavior.
